simulatedPerson.hiddenRule: Likes lyrical or experimental prose (90%); rich figuration elsewhere 35%; otherwise 8%.

interpretation.summary: Across 50 passages from 30 books, the clearest pattern is in what you pass over: restraint.

sections.title: Restraint
sections.text: The passages you passed over consistently share restrained prose (2 of 15 liked) and short sentences (0 of 9 liked). Plain words and few figures of speech leave feeling unstated; the reader infers what the prose declines to say, so small details carry a great deal. For instance synthetic-05 (restrained), synthetic-17 (restrained) and synthetic-21 (restrained). Yet you did like synthetic-01 (restrained) (restrained prose, but not short sentences) and synthetic-13 (restrained) (restrained prose, but not short sentences). Part of this rests on subjective readings of mood.

claims.statement: The passages you passed over consistently share restrained prose (2 of 15 liked) and short sentences (0 of 9 liked).

sections.title: How sure this is
sections.text: Some characteristics cannot yet be told apart because they occur in nearly the same passages: restrained prose with short sentences. All of this compares your own likes with your own dislikes among 50 passages; it is not a comparison with anyone else.
